## HERA — Step 3c: low-field onset extension, electron side (`sdh-spot-check`), n = +3.2×10¹² at D = 0, B 0.25 → 1.2 T

> **05:26** · sdh-spot-check low-field onset extension, e-side: n=+3.2e12 D=0 (Vtg +0.984, Vbg +1.166), B 0.25->1.2 T uniform-1/B 96 pts, delay 0 (3 s settle), sr1 20 uV; ends at 1.2 T · **ETA ~05:51** (≈25 min)

**Why this before the fan.** The spot-check read (ana, runs 6/7) puts the fan on the electron side: run 6 carries a strong tone set {7.1, 22.1, 29.5} T (+14.1 T) at n = +3.2×10¹² — 7.1 + 22.1 = 29.2 ≈ the 29.5 T tone, i.e. the {f₁, f₂, ≈F_L} set the investigation flags as underdetermined (ABAB pair + symmetry-allowed breakdown sum-tone, or a singleton at F_L with scale 0.89) — while run 7 (hole, n = −1.2×10¹²) sits in the model's low-|n| close-pair regime (5.3/7.0/12.3 T, messy). The fan's job is the F(n) trajectory + Luttinger sum across n. `landau-fan` step 1 lever (1): B_lo = the *measured* onset — and `sdh_onset` on run 6 returns the carrying 7.1 T tone **censored at the record edge (0.30 T)**, with run 6's sub-1 T leg at 50 mT, which under-samples a 7 T tone below ~0.85 T (aliased, not a measurement). The recipe's branch for a censored carrying tone is a cheap low-field extension before committing the long fan; B_lo is the ±3 h lever here (uniform-1/B rows ∝ 1/B_lo: 0.7 T vs 1.0 T is ~150 vs ~105 rows), and the model partner tone at n = 2×10¹² (3.5 T) needs a 1/B span ≥ 1.4 T⁻¹ (B_lo ≈ 0.65 T) for ≥ 5 periods.

**Design.** Same gate point as run 6 (n = +3.2, D = 0 → V_tg = +0.984, V_bg = +1.166 V). Field uniform in 1/B (`field_invB`, 96 pts, 0.25 → 1.2 T ascending — the magnet sits at 0 T): Δ(1/B) = 0.033 T⁻¹ = 3 pts/period on a 10 T tone, 4.2 on 7.1 T (the 22–30 T tones are dead below their 1.4–1.9 T onsets, so nothing to alias); overlaps run 6's 10 mT leg over 1.0–1.2 T for a cross-check. Uniform-1/B rather than the recipe's uniform-B branch because on this rig the per-point overhead (~8 s) dominates a 1 T traverse (7 min) — 96 points instead of ~230 for the same Nyquist. `delay = 0`: each blocking set + 3 s driver settle = 10 τ (τ = 0.3 s, 24 dB/oct). sr1 at **20 µV (2 kΩ FS)**: run 6 read ≤ 57 Ω below 1.04 T → 3 % of FS, 35× headroom, 2.5× finer digitisation than run 6's 50 µV for the low-B oscillation amplitude. Leak trip 1 nA on both Keithleys (TG at +0.98 V ran at ~0 pA baseline in run 6).

**Price.** From run 6 (14.6 s/pt at 10 mT steps incl. ramp): ~13 s/pt here → 96 pts ≈ 21 min + 0 → 0.25 T ramp 2 min + gate ramps → ≈ 25 min. Ends at **1.2 T with the gates at the spot**; the fan then starts at its pinned B_lo (≤ 1 T, a < 6 min re-traverse) and ascends to 10 T.

**Checkpoints.** First ~10 rows: signal present, no rail, TG/BG currents at baseline, field readback tracking 1/B setpoints. Read: `sdh_onset` on the joined record (this run + run 6 above 1 T) → the 7.1 T tone's onset is the fan's B_lo.

```python
# === Low-field onset extension, electron side (`sdh-spot-check`): n = +3.2e12 at D = 0 (region-A calibration), B 0.25 -> 1.2 T uniform in 1/B ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration; ratio data-calibrated, scale = geometry prior) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
n_spot, D_spot = 3.2, 0.0                       # 1e12 cm^-2, V/nm — same point as run 6
Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot = calc_gate_voltages(n_spot, D_spot, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert TG_MIN <= Vtg_spot <= TG_MAX and BG_MIN <= Vbg_spot <= BG_MAX, (Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot)
print(f"spot: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm -> (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}) V; "
      f"roundtrip n,D = {calc_nD(Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot, CAL['c_tg'], CAL['c_bg'], CAL['n_offset'], CAL['D_offset'])}")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05: handoff left it at 0), V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), "
      f"nplci tg/bg = {k_tg.nplci()}/{k_bg.nplci()} (1/1), PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()

# --- field grid: uniform in 1/B, ascending 0.25 -> 1.2 T. Delta(1/B) = 0.033 1/T = 3 pts/period at 10 T, 4.2 at 7.1 T.
B_vec = field_invB(0.25, 1.2, 96)
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP and B_vec.min() > 0 and np.all(np.diff(B_vec) > 0)
_dinv = np.abs(np.diff(1 / B_vec))
I_TRIP = 1e-9
# Fixed sensitivity: 20 uV = 2 kOhm full scale at 10 nA (run 6: R <= 57 Ohm below 1.04 T -> 3 % FS).
sr1.sensitivity(20e-6)
print(f"B grid: {len(B_vec)} pts, {B_vec[0]:.3f} -> {B_vec[-1]:.3f} T, d(1/B) = {_dinv.mean():.4f} 1/T (dB {1e3*np.diff(B_vec).min():.1f}-{1e3*np.diff(B_vec).max():.1f} mT); "
      f"sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V, tau {sr1.time_constant()} s / {sr1.filter_slope()} dB (settle_s {magnet.settle_s} s = dwell)")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = f"sdh-spot-check electron low-field onset extension: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm (run-5 cal), (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}), B 0.25 -> 1.2 T uniform-1/B 96 pts, sr1 20 uV"
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('sdh-spot-check')
s.add_comment(f'low-field onset extension of run 6 (electron side): n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12 cm^-2, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm; (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}); '
              f'B 0.25 -> 1.2 T uniform-1/B (96 pts, d(1/B) 0.033 1/T); sr1 20 uV; cal run 5: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f}')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_spot); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_spot)
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B, T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(magnet.field, sr1.X); s.plot(magnet.field, sr0.X); s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[3])), abs(float(data[4]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

s.sweep(magnet.field, B_vec, delay=0)
# gates stay at the spot; field ends at 1.2 T (the fan starts at its pinned B_lo <= 1 T) — no park here.
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f})")
```

**Design.** Same gate point as run 6 (n = +3.2, D = 0 → V_tg = +0.984, V_bg = +1.166 V). Field uniform in 1/B (`field_invB`, 96 pts, 0.25 → 1.2 T ascending — the magnet sits at 0 T): Δ(1/B) = 0.033 T⁻¹ = 3 pts/period on a 10 T tone, 4.2 on 7.1 T (the 22–30 T tones are dead below their 1.4–1.9 T onsets, so nothing to alias); overlaps run 6's 10 mT leg over 1.0–1.2 T for a cross-check. Uniform-1/B rather than the recipe's uniform-B branch because on this rig the per-point overhead (~8 s) dominates a 1 T traverse (7 min) — 96 points instead of ~230 for the same Nyquist. `delay = 0`: each blocking set + 3 s driver settle = 10 τ (τ = 0.3 s, 24 dB/oct). sr1 at **20 µV (2 kΩ FS)**: run 6 read ≤ 57 Ω below 1.04 T → 3 % of FS, 35× headroom, 2.5× finer digitisation than run 6's 50 µV for the low-B oscillation amplitude. Leak trip 1 nA on both Keithleys (TG at +0.98 V ran at ~0 pA baseline in run 6).

**Price.** From run 6 (14.6 s/pt at 10 mT steps incl. ramp): ~13 s/pt here → 96 pts ≈ 21 min + 0 → 0.25 T ramp 2 min + gate ramps → ≈ 25 min. Ends at **1.2 T with the gates at the spot**; the fan then starts at its pinned B_lo (≤ 1 T, a < 6 min re-traverse) and ascends to 10 T.
